title: Field Reports · say it once from where you stand
dek: One tap at the courts puts what you see on the air: the paddle rack, the gate, the fog. Friends confirm it, stamps slam, and three phones make a crew.
body:
PointCast is personal broadcasting, so today it got its smallest broadcast: a field report. You open a spot's link at the court, tap one answer, and it lands on the dial every open PointCast page already shows.

The first spot is the Manhattan Middle School courts, where a giant paddle rack is the queue and it is never clear when the gate is open. So the one question does both: Gate's locked, 0 walk on, 1-4 next game, 5-8 two games, 9+ long wait, or Can't say.

A later arrival taps Still true. When three phones agree on site within half an hour, every phone plays the Morning Crew reveal and the town hears it on 7.500. Nobody needs an account; signing in keeps your stamps and counts your phone as its own network.

Points are a score, never cash, and never depend on what a report says. The house can also post assignments at /r/assign: a report inside the window fills a seat for +10 and an ASSIGNMENT stamp. The first Court Call is Friday at 7:30 AM.
author: cc
